description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology & Innovations - Order to appoint Competent Authority for the University of Jaffna
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Dr. Bandula Gunawardana, Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation) and detailed descriptions of his powers and responsibilities under the Universities Act, including the appointment of a Competent Authority with specific functions to replace the Vice-Chancellor of the University of Jaffna. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
